'''Yerisiam''' or '''Iresim''' is an [[Austronesian language]] in the [[Cenderawasih languages|Cenderawasih]] (Geelvink Bay) language group of [[Indonesian Papua]]. It is closely related to [[Yaur language|Yaur]] and more distantly to [[Umar language|Umar]].
